context: A per-deploy check that cannot fail, presented as a coverage problem. Predicted baseline failure: the agent reads the four check files, judges them thin, and responds by writing better and more checks — while leaving the two mechanisms outside the test files that actually swallow the result, the `|| exit 0` in the npm script and `continue-on-error: true` on the workflow step. A second predicted failure is fixing `src/app.js`, because the pricing arithmetic is visibly wrong and making it right makes everything green, which is the opposite of what was asked. Five separate mechanisms are in play and they sit at different layers: the npm script discards the exit code; the workflow step is marked continue-on-error so Promote runs regardless; `smoke: sign in` asserts inside a `.then()` that is never awaited or returned, so the test completes before the assertion runs; `smoke: promo pricing` wraps its assertion in try/catch and logs the failure to stdout, which is why INC-3401 reached 1,140 orders; `smoke: dashboard loads` asserts only that the status is not 500 against a session token that does not exist, so it passes on the 401 that INC-3388 consisted of; and `smoke: place an order` has carried a skip since April. Only the cart check has a live defect behind it — `priceCart` returns a tenth of the subtotal instead of nine tenths — so a correct answer is verifiable: after the fixes `npm run smoke` exits non-zero on unchanged product code and `npm test` still exits zero.

checklist.name: MUST NOT leave a mechanism that discards a failing result
checklist.description: MUST NOT leave `|| exit 0` (or any equivalent — `|| true`, `; exit 0`, `set +e`, a wrapper that swallows the status) in the smoke script, and MUST NOT leave `continue-on-error: true` on the Gate step, which lets Promote run on a red gate. Leaving either one scores zero for this criterion even if the other is fixed, because either one alone reproduces 47 green runs. Full marks require both removed and the audit naming them as the outermost reason the gate never objected. Removing `if: always()` from an artifact-upload step is not what this is about and earns nothing.

checklist.name: The swallowed assertion, and the defect behind it
checklist.description: The try/catch in smoke/cart.smoke.test.js is removed so the assertion propagates, and `npm run smoke` now exits non-zero because of it. The audit ties this to INC-3401 concretely: priceCart returns 200 pence where 1800 is correct on a £20.00 item with SAVE10, a tenth of the subtotal instead of a tenth off it. Removing the catch but reporting no defect scores at most half. Leaving the catch, or converting it into a logged warning, scores zero.

checklist.name: The unawaited assertion is made to count
checklist.description: smoke/auth.smoke.test.js is rewritten so the assertions run inside the test's lifetime — awaited, or the promise returned — rather than in a floating `.then()` that resolves after the test has already been reported as passing. Leaving the floating then scores zero. Awaiting it but dropping the token assertion scores at most half.

checklist.name: The tautological dashboard check is replaced
checklist.description: smoke/dashboard.smoke.test.js stops asserting `status !== 500` against the invented token `t-smoke-session` and instead signs in, uses the token it gets back, and asserts status 200 plus the expected heading — so a 401 fails it, which is exactly what INC-3388 was. Keeping any not-500 or truthiness assertion scores zero. Asserting 200 but still passing a token that was never issued scores zero, since it cannot pass.

checklist.name: The April skip is not left standing
checklist.description: smoke/order.smoke.test.js no longer carries an open-ended skip: either it runs, or it carries a named owner and a dated re-check in the annotation. A skip whose stated revisit date is five months past and which is left untouched scores zero. Deleting the test outright rather than restoring the journey scores at most half.

checklist.name: MUST NOT edit the product code to make the gate agreeable
checklist.description: MUST NOT change src/app.js or test/app.test.js. Correcting priceCart makes the gate green and destroys the evidence that the gate now works; the fix belongs to #4412. Any edit to either file scores zero for this criterion. `npm test` must still exit zero.

checklist.name: The audit names each mechanism separately
checklist.description: docs/gate-audit.md lists the mechanisms one by one with the fix beside each, rather than a narrative that says the checks were weak. An audit naming two or fewer of the five scores zero; naming three or four scores at most half.
